cards.example_en: We looked into the dark cave.
cards.example_zh: 我们向黑暗的洞穴里看。

cards.example_en: The noise will cease after nine o'clock.
cards.example_zh: 九点以后噪音就会停止。

cards.example_en: A lamp hung from the ceiling.
cards.example_zh: 一盏灯挂在天花板上。

cards.example_en: The celebrity signed a few books.
cards.example_zh: 那位名人签了几本书。

cards.example_en: Each cell in the leaf needs sunlight to live.
cards.example_zh: 叶子里的每个细胞都需要阳光才能存活。

cards.example_en: The insect is one centimetre long.
cards.example_zh: 这只昆虫长一厘米。

cards.example_en: I will certainly help you with the project.
cards.example_zh: 我一定会帮你做这个项目。

cards.example_en: She received a certificate after the swimming test.
cards.example_zh: 游泳测验之后，她拿到了证书。

cards.example_en: He locked his bike with a strong chain.
cards.example_zh: 他用一根结实的链条把自行车锁上了。

cards.example_en: The chairman opened the meeting with a short speech.
cards.example_zh: 主席用一段简短的讲话开始了会议。

cards.example_en: The chairwoman opened the meeting.
cards.example_zh: 女主席宣布会议开始。

cards.example_en: Boats passed through a narrow channel near the island.
cards.example_zh: 船只从岛附近一条狭窄的通道经过。

cards.example_en: The sudden alarm caused chaos.
cards.example_zh: 突然的警报引起了一片混乱。

cards.example_en: The last chapter of the novel made her cry.
cards.example_zh: 小说的最后一章让她哭了。

cards.example_en: The police dropped the charge after new evidence appeared.
cards.example_zh: 新证据出现后，警方撤销了这项指控。

cards.example_en: The weather chart shows rain for the whole week.
cards.example_zh: 天气图表显示整整一周都会下雨。

cards.example_en: She kissed her mother on the cheek before school.
cards.example_zh: 上学前，她亲了亲妈妈的脸颊。

cards.example_en: The chef prepared a simple lunch.
cards.example_zh: 厨师准备了一顿简单的午餐。

cards.example_en: Store the chemical away from food.
cards.example_zh: 把化学品放在远离食物的地方。

cards.example_en: The chemist explained the experiment.
cards.example_zh: 化学家讲解了这个实验。

cards.example_en: He felt a pain in his chest after the race.
cards.example_zh: 比赛结束后，他感到胸口疼痛。

cards.example_en: Chew your food slowly during family dinner.
cards.example_zh: 家庭晚餐时要慢慢咀嚼食物。

cards.example_en: Safety is the chief concern when we use the science lab.
cards.example_zh: 我们使用科学实验室时，安全是最主要的考虑。

cards.example_en: The plate is made of fine china.
cards.example_zh: 这只盘子是细瓷做的。

cards.example_en: Chew slowly so you do not choke.
cards.example_zh: 慢慢嚼，免得呛到。

cards.example_en: The chorus sang the last song together.
cards.example_zh: 合唱队一起唱了最后一首歌。

cards.example_en: My grandparents walk to church on Sunday morning.
cards.example_zh: 我的祖父母星期天早上步行去教堂。

cards.example_en: He threw the cigarette away before entering school.
cards.example_zh: 进学校之前，他把香烟扔了。

cards.example_en: A broken circuit left the desk lamp dark.
cards.example_zh: 电路坏了，台灯就不亮了。

cards.example_en: Under no circumstance should you open the door.
cards.example_zh: 任何情况下都不要开门。

cards.example_en: The circus came to town in May.
cards.example_zh: 马戏团五月来到了镇上。

cards.example_en: Cite the book if you use its idea.
cards.example_zh: 如果用了书里的观点，请注明出处。

cards.example_en: The poster listed basic civil rights beside the classroom door.
cards.example_zh: 海报在教室门边列出了基本的公民权利。

cards.example_en: The bridge is for civilian use.
cards.example_zh: 这座桥供平民使用。

cards.example_en: The museum shows an ancient civilisation.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆展示一种古代文明。

cards.example_en: Some students claim that the test was too hard.
cards.example_zh: 有些学生声称这次考试太难了。

cards.example_en: The audience began to clap.
cards.example_zh: 观众开始鼓掌。

cards.example_en: Could you clarify the last point?
cards.example_zh: 你能澄清最后一点吗？

cards.example_en: The students shaped a bowl from clay.
cards.example_zh: 学生们用黏土捏了一只碗。

cards.example_en: The clerk checked my student card.
cards.example_zh: 职员查看了我的学生证。

cards.example_en: The shopkeeper greeted a regular client by name.
cards.example_zh: 店主喊着名字招呼一位老主顾。

cards.example_en: The clinic is open until six.
cards.example_zh: 诊所营业到六点。

cards.example_en: Scientists can clone some plants.
cards.example_zh: 科学家可以克隆某些植物。

cards.example_en: Wipe the table with a clean cloth.
cards.example_zh: 用干净的布擦桌子。

cards.example_en: The footprint was an important clue.
cards.example_zh: 脚印是一条重要线索。

cards.example_en: The old train used coal.
cards.example_zh: 那列旧火车用煤。

cards.example_en: The old wall may collapse in a storm.
cards.example_zh: 旧墙可能在暴风雨中倒塌。

cards.example_en: His collar was crooked.
cards.example_zh: 他的衣领歪了。

cards.example_en: This collection of ghost stories is the favourite book in our class.
cards.example_zh: 这本鬼故事合集是我们班最喜欢的书。

cards.example_en: Mum writes a cooking column for the local Sunday paper.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈为当地的星期日报写美食专栏。

word.example_en: Mr Zhao is in charge of the lab.
Lin will take charge of the stage lights.
word.example_zh: 林将负责掌管舞台灯光。
